summary: File ownership, boundaries, state and collaborators.

Source contracts: src/agent_runtime/monitors

src/agent_runtime/monitors/init.py

Python · Tier A

Persistent Agent UI monitor contracts and store.

src/agent_runtime/monitors/drafting.py

Python · Tier A

Propose and validate monitor settings for the explicit draft/create workflow. Prompt heuristics or an optional structured model produce a command, condition, cadence and bounded duration; common resource probes become parseable commands. validate_monitor_draft/create normalize proposals and reject known destructive or interactive forms, while draft_monitor_from_prompt falls back to deterministic rules after provider/schema failure. These heuristics do not implement a complete shell security policy, persist records or run commands; the manager, Gateway and accepted execution scope own those effects.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
MonitorSpecValidationError 101 Raised when a monitor spec cannot be made safe enough to run.
duration_seconds_from_prompt 141 Read the first supported 'for' duration in seconds, minutes or hours, falling back to 300 seconds. Draft validation later applies the configured maximum.
interval_seconds_from_prompt 154 Prefer a watch -n interval, then a supported 'every' seconds/minutes phrase, otherwise five seconds. Return a positive integer for the sampling loop.
condition_from_prompt 193 Infer supported numeric threshold or explicit text conditions. GB/GiB thresholds become integer MiB values; qualitative conditions remain for the separate judge path.
natural_language_condition_from_prompt 228 Extract a conditional phrase for model judgement. Retain it when no deterministic condition exists or when qualitative keywords also occur; otherwise return an empty judge condition.
command_from_prompt 279 Build a command/mode proposal from an explicit backtick, known resource probe or supported command phrase. Recognize streaming forms, but return missing-command details when no supported probe can be inferred; no command executes here.
monitor_command_rejection_reason 347 Return a reason for missing commands, known destructive patterns, unsupported interactive forms or nonpositive raw-stream duration. The regex and first-command checks are heuristics, not a complete shell security boundary.
validate_monitor_draft 429 Normalize the command, duration, cadence, trigger mode and preview metadata into a fresh draft. Raise MonitorSpecValidationError for rejected commands; known probes may be rewritten, and watch/tail streaming forms force raw_stream mode.
validate_monitor_create 487 Apply draft normalization before manager-owned creation while retaining the accepted context, Gateway, conversation, mode and initial status. This validation creates no records and does not run the command.
deterministic_monitor_draft_response 588 Recognize explicit monitor intent and return one normalized heuristic draft. A rejected candidate becomes an incomplete zero-confidence draft with an empty command and actionable missing details; it is never executed here.
llm_monitor_spec 768 Request and validate a structured monitor specification in a fresh drafting prompt-cache scope; provider, schema and validation errors propagate to the caller's deterministic fallback.
draft_monitor_from_prompt 796 Return no draft without recognized intent. Prefer deterministic handling of a backticked command; otherwise try the enabled model drafter and fall back on unavailable, invalid or failed proposals. This workflow proposes settings without persisting or starting a monitor.

src/agent_runtime/monitors/management.py

Python · Tier A

Share revision-checked monitor definition edits between RAM and standalone stores. DefinitionPatch permits only named definition fields with bounded values and rejects empty/null patches; check requires the exact observed revision and a stopped record before mutation or deletion. The manager additionally checks worker liveness. This path retains captured authority and does not restart execution, redraft commands or rerun the full creation heuristics.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
DefinitionPatch 17 Allow only editable monitor definition fields with bounded values. Runtime status, captured authority, execution IDs and observations cannot be replaced through this schema; it does not rerun the command-drafting safety heuristics.
DefinitionPatch.nonempty 33 Reject an empty patch or explicitly null supplied fields while preserving omitted values for partial updates.
check 44 Require an existing record with exactly the caller's observed updated_at and no open lifecycle/execution state. Raise typed not-found/conflict errors before either store mutates or deletes it; manager callers separately check worker liveness.

src/agent_runtime/monitors/manager.py

Python · Tier A

Coordinate monitor workers, Gateway terminals, condition evaluation and linked action tasks. AgentMonitorManager owns thread/cancellation handles and judge cadence, while the store owns definitions and evidence. Sampling collects completed commands; streaming evaluates individual arriving chunks. Optional model judgement has cadence, confidence and native lifetime-budget gates. Duration and stop requests are cooperative, trigger effects span separate stores/callbacks, and bounded history helpers have documented prefix limits. Restart interruption records recovery state without automatically resuming remote work.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
AgentMonitorManagerError 60 Base error for monitor manager operations.
AgentMonitorNotFoundError 64 Raised when a monitor id does not exist.
AgentMonitorConflictError 68 Raised when a monitor operation conflicts with current state.
MonitorCancellation 72 Wake a monitor blocked in network I/O as soon as its cancellation is requested.
MonitorCancellation.set 81 Not yet documented
monitor_output_text 88 Join nonblank combined output, stdout and stderr in that order for condition evaluation. Inputs are not clipped or deduplicated by this helper.
monitor_condition_match 95 Evaluate case-insensitive contains/regex, the first numeric token against a threshold, nonzero exit status or plain-text substring fallback. Return match evidence; malformed thresholds do not match, while invalid regex syntax raises to the worker's failure handler.
AgentMonitorManager 140 Own worker handles, cancellation flags and judge cadence for stored monitors. Injected Gateway, task and model services perform external work; each monitor retains one captured Gateway, and lifecycle updates do not prove remote process termination.
AgentMonitorManager.interrupt_active_monitors 165 Mark recoverable open records interrupted through the store after restart; this bookkeeping neither restarts workers nor cancels a remote command.
AgentMonitorManager.draft_monitor 170 Select the configured drafting provider, limits and enablement, then return a proposal through the explicit drafting workflow without creating a monitor.
AgentMonitorManager.record_payload 189 Project a stored monitor with its optional latest observation and up to 20 newest trigger records for API/tool callers. Serialization itself does not redact context or output.
AgentMonitorManager.observation_payload 212 Convert a model or mapping observation to JSON-compatible record data without independently clipping or redacting it.
AgentMonitorManager.list_monitors 221 Return at most 500 selected monitor payloads plus store-wide status counts; visible page length is not the total count.
AgentMonitorManager.create_monitor 241 Validate and normalize a complete monitor specification, persist it, and optionally start its worker. Translate specification rejection into a manager conflict; persistence may already exist if later startup fails.
AgentMonitorManager.get_monitor 261 Return one enriched monitor payload or raise the typed missing-monitor error used by API and native callers.
AgentMonitorManager.list_observations 269 Require the monitor to exist, return an ascending sequence page after the exclusive cursor and attach up to 100 newest triggers. Clamp observation page size to 1–1000.
AgentMonitorManager.stream_events 292 Emit SSE status changes and ascending observation pages of 100 at half-second polls. End after two terminal-status cycles or disappearance; paused monitors continue waiting, and this generator does not independently own worker cancellation.
AgentMonitorManager.start_monitor 334 Under the manager lock, reject missing/archived records and reuse an existing running worker. Otherwise clear prior error/summary/execution fields, mark queued and launch the tracked sampling or streaming thread; return its current stored projection.
AgentMonitorManager.cancel_monitor 395 Signal the local worker and best-effort cancel its recorded Gateway execution, then store paused/cancelled state and clear the execution ID. Remote cancellation failures are suppressed and this method does not join the worker.
AgentMonitorManager.archive_monitor 432 Cancel a monitor whose recorded status is running, then mark it archived. Hiding the record does not delete observations, triggers or independent launched tasks.
AgentMonitorManager.update_definition 443 Require any tracked worker to have settled, then delegate the revision-checked definition patch. This route neither restarts work nor reruns full creation/draft normalization.
AgentMonitorManager.delete_definition 460 Reject a live worker, delete the revision-checked monitor and its observation/trigger history, then discard local handles and judge cadence. Previously created tasks and notifications remain independent.
AgentMonitorManager._maybe_llm_judge 756 Judge only enabled natural-language/hybrid monitors at the greater global/local cadence. Reserve native lifetime budget before a model call, validate structured output and store a summary; unavailable providers, exhausted budget or model errors retain diagnostics and allow observation collection to continue.
AgentMonitorManager._run_sample_loop 865 Open the captured Gateway terminal, execute and collect one command at a time, evaluate output and persist observations until triggered, cancelled or the loop deadline is reached. Duration is checked between commands; transport work may overrun it. Context resolution precedes the guarded worker body, whose failures are recorded and handles cleared.
AgentMonitorManager._run_raw_stream 974 Run one Gateway command and evaluate each arriving output event independently, storing observations and best-effort cancelling on trigger/deadline. Cancellation closes owned transports even during silent streams; matches do not combine text across chunks. Guarded failures record monitor errors and clear worker handles.

src/agent_runtime/monitors/memory_store.py

Python · Tier A

Implement monitor lifecycle and observation/trigger history on the live Controller RAM authority. MonitorRecords maintains status, visibility, sequence and trigger indexes within atomic publications; MemoryMonitorStore provides revision checks, observation-pointer updates, judge-budget reservations and creation-time pruning of settled history. Detached records prevent callers mutating authoritative state. RecordRepository imports recovery tables and the shared checkpoint owner saves them; live access never falls back to SQLite or launches Gateway work.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
initialize 38 Initialize the supported monitor recovery schema and stable insertion-order tables for replay into the RAM authority; this runs during repository initialization, not normal observation writes.
schemas 51 Describe monitor, observation, trigger and insertion-order recovery columns, keys and JSON fields for RecordRepository import/checkpoint handling.
MonitorRecords 69 Maintain monitor status/visibility, observation sequence and trigger-time indexes alongside transactional records, while notifying native continuation dependencies of monitor changes.
MonitorRecords.changed 73 Apply index removals/additions and stable insertion ordinals within the enclosing transaction. Monitor mutations invalidate native wait dependencies; deletion removes corresponding order metadata.
decode 122 Thaw a detached stored row into its Pydantic record, normalizing legacy trigger mode and judge interval defaults; return None for an absent row.
MemoryMonitorStore 141 Implement the live Controller monitor repository over atomic RAM publications and ordered indexes. Recovery/checkpoint services own disk persistence; this adapter never falls back to SQL for runtime operations.
MemoryMonitorStore.create_monitor 177 Assign a monitor identity, timestamps and fallback title, publish its definition and prune excess settled history atomically; no worker starts in the store.
MemoryMonitorStore.get_monitor 195 Read a detached validated monitor record from the RAM repository, returning None when the identity is absent.
MemoryMonitorStore.list_monitors 203 Read a bounded indexed page using status priority and update order, with explicit archived visibility. Selection is independent of the manager's worker handles.
MemoryMonitorStore.reserve_native_judgement 238 Atomically increment the monitor's persisted native inference count up to its configured lifetime limit (32 by default). Reject a missing record or exhausted budget before model work begins.
MemoryMonitorStore.update_monitor 263 Apply allowed runtime fields, clip stored previews and set first lifecycle timestamps in one publication. Preserve captured authority and command settings; title remains an allowed runtime field.
MemoryMonitorStore.manage_definition 313 Check the observed revision and stopped state inside one transaction, then apply the permitted definition patch or delete the monitor and its observation/trigger children. Independent task and notification records remain untouched.
MemoryMonitorStore.add_observation 344 Publish a clipped observation and its monitor's latest-observation pointer together, with copied detail and sequence metadata. A failed transaction exposes neither a partial pointer nor partial indexes.
MemoryMonitorStore.get_observation 391 Return a detached observation by exact identity, or None if it is absent or pruned.
MemoryMonitorStore.list_observations 402 Return up to 1000 observations in ascending sequence/insertion order, strictly after the supplied sequence cursor. This API returns the earliest matching page, not a newest-first tail.
MemoryMonitorStore.add_trigger 419 Require the monitor to exist and append its trigger receipt with optional observation, task and notification references. The manager separately changes monitor state and launches work.
MemoryMonitorStore.get_trigger 451 Read one detached trigger receipt by identity, returning None for an unknown or pruned record.
MemoryMonitorStore.list_triggers 459 Read the newest trigger receipts for one monitor through the ordered index, bounded to 1–500 items.
MemoryMonitorStore.counts 470 Count indexed visible lifecycle states and archived records separately without constructing full monitor payloads.
MemoryMonitorStore.interrupt_active_monitors 493 Atomically mark visible queued/running/paused records interrupted, preserve an existing error reason and clear execution IDs after restart. It records recovery state without dispatching or cancelling commands.
MemoryMonitorStore.archive_monitor 519 Set archived status and visibility timestamp through the ordinary update path, retaining history until retention or explicit deletion removes it.

src/agent_runtime/monitors/models.py

Python · Tier A

Define monitor draft/create/update, persisted observation/trigger and structured judgement contracts. monitor_gateway_context validates captured single-Gateway intent; creation also normalizes title and behavior policy, while draft requests reject public model-route overrides. Pydantic schemas describe data, not command execution or authorization. The manager applies command/duration heuristics, confidence/cadence rules and lifecycle effects; stores encode records and apply output limits. Runtime field descriptions, defaults and existing docstrings remain unchanged.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
monitor_gateway_context 50 Copy accepted context, apply the explicit Gateway ID and validate any structured selection as exactly one matching primary. Reject sibling targets rather than silently widening a monitor's execution scope.
AgentMonitorDraft 65 One monitor draft extracted from a user prompt.
AgentMonitorDraftRequest 91 Prompt and context used to draft monitor settings.
AgentMonitorDraftRequest.controller_models 102 Reject public model-route overrides before validating the draft request so Controller model configuration remains the routing authority.
AgentMonitorDraftResponse 112 Draft response for monitor creation.
AgentMonitorDraftSpec 123 Structured LLM proposal for one monitor specification.
AgentMonitorJudgement 147 Validate structured model evidence, confidence and suggested action context; a valid response is still subject to manager confidence/cadence/budget rules and cannot grant execution authority.
AgentMonitorCreate 160 Create one persistent monitor.
AgentMonitorUpdate 205 Describe optional runtime lifecycle, terminal, trigger and summary fields for store updates; definition edits use the separate revision-checked DefinitionPatch contract.
AgentMonitorRecord 226 Represent the persisted monitor definition, accepted execution context, lifecycle timestamps and latest-evidence pointers. A recorded status is separate from the physical Gateway process or an action task's outcome.
AgentMonitorObservationRecord 270 Store one sequenced command/stream observation with output, exit status, match evidence and optional judge details; the store applies preview limits before persistence.
AgentMonitorTriggerRecord 292 Link trigger evidence to its monitor and any created task/notification without implying that the action task has finished.

src/agent_runtime/monitors/store.py

Python · Tier A

Select the live RAM monitor repository when a Controller hub owns the path, otherwise provide the standalone SQLite implementation. AgentMonitorStore records definitions, clipped observations, trigger receipts, revision-checked edits and lifetime judge-call reservations under version-2 storage rules. Shared helpers encode metadata and normalize recovery values; creation prunes settled monitor history while preserving open records. Explicit deletion removes child histories, whereas standalone retention only explicitly deletes monitor rows. Workers, model calls and checkpoint scheduling belong to separate owners.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
utc_now_iso 40 Return an ISO timestamp in UTC.
AgentMonitorStore 82 Persist monitors, observations, and trigger records.
AgentMonitorStore.create_monitor 161 Insert a timestamped monitor definition with fallback title under the store lock and prune settled history. Return the stored record without creating a terminal or worker.
AgentMonitorStore.get_monitor 205 Read and decode the exact monitor ID from standalone storage, or return None when it is absent.
AgentMonitorStore.list_monitors 215 Select a bounded status/visibility-filtered page ordered by lifecycle priority and update time; archived visibility is separate from worker state.
AgentMonitorStore.reserve_native_judgement 246 Reserve one persisted native judge call in an immediate transaction, rejecting exhausted lifetime budget before inference. Failed model calls still consume their reserved slot.
AgentMonitorStore.update_monitor 274 Apply the runtime-field allowlist, clip preview values and stamp first lifecycle transitions under the store lock. Retain authority and command settings and update the revision; title is allowed.
AgentMonitorStore.manage_definition 329 Use an immediate transaction to check expected_updated_at and stopped state before patching allowed definition fields or deleting the definition with its observations/triggers. Existing tasks and notifications are separate records.
AgentMonitorStore.add_observation 366 Insert clipped output and match/judge detail, then update the monitor's latest-observation pointer in the same SQL transaction; no command evaluation occurs here.
AgentMonitorStore.get_observation 419 Decode one observation by identity, returning None when no matching row exists.
AgentMonitorStore.list_observations 429 Read the earliest matching sequence page after the exclusive cursor, ordered ascending and bounded to 1–1000 records.
AgentMonitorStore.add_trigger 454 Insert a linked trigger receipt in one transaction; monitor state changes, task dispatch and notification creation occur separately in the manager.
AgentMonitorStore.get_trigger 488 Return one decoded trigger receipt by exact identity or None for an absent row.
AgentMonitorStore.list_triggers 498 Return up to 500 newest trigger receipts for one monitor without loading associated task or notification payloads.
AgentMonitorStore.counts 515 Group visible monitor rows by lifecycle state and count archived rows separately for management summaries.
AgentMonitorStore.interrupt_active_monitors 532 Mark visible queued/running/paused records interrupted after restart, retaining prior errors and clearing execution IDs. This recovery update does not control a remote process.
AgentMonitorStore.archive_monitor 554 Record archived lifecycle and timestamp through update_monitor, preserving associated history until independently removed.
initialize_monitor_schema 578 Create/check version-2 monitor, observation and trigger tables plus their indexes for standalone use or RAM recovery import. Unsupported schema versions fail before normal operations; declared references alone do not enable SQLite foreign-key enforcement.
